## Shirasagi no Mai (White Heron Dance) (November 3)

Shirasagi no Mai, a traditional performing art of Senso-ji, features dancers in costumes modeled after white herons who gracefully walk in procession around the temple grounds. It is performed several times a year, and one of those performances takes place on November 3.

With gorgeous costumes adorned with white feathers and slow, graceful dancing set to the melodies of gagaku (court music), the dance draws viewers into a mysterious and profound world.

A popular autumn tradition in Asakusa, it is also a favorite among tourists, and the temple grounds bustle with spectators holding their cameras. It is a valuable opportunity to experience traditional culture and has become one of the highlights of sightseeing in Asakusa.

137.title: Hagoita-ichi (Battledore Fair)
137.summary: An annual year-end battledore fair held on the temple grounds to coincide with the Osame no Kannon festival day.
137.body:
## Hagoita-ichi (Battledore Fair)

Every year from December 17 to 19, the annual year-end "Hagoita-ichi" (Battledore Fair) is held on the grounds of Senso-ji Temple. It takes place to coincide with "Osame no Kannon" (the final Kannon festival day of the year) on December 18, and is known as a traditional fair that has continued since the Edo period.

Stalls line the grounds, packed with hagoita (decorative battledores) adorned with gorgeous oshie (padded fabric relief) designs. **Kawari hagoita** (novelty battledores) modeled on kabuki actors and people in the news are also popular, and the fair draws many visitors and tourists every year.

The lively calls of sellers and buyers, and the sight of **tejime** (rhythmic hand-clapping) performed when a deal is struck, are also hallmarks of the Hagoita-ichi.

Decorating Asakusa at the close of the year, this fair is an important event that gives local residents a sense of wrapping up the year.

This is a one-day-only performance on **September 20, 2026**, with multiple ticket sales formats available, including Kokonoge advance sales and general sales. Attention is also drawn to the staging that makes the most of the Asakusa Kokonoge stage space.

The performance is aimed at audiences seeking the immersive atmosphere unique to live theater, and crowds are expected before and after the show on the day. Tickets can be purchased from the official website, and securing them early is recommended.

155.title: Musical "Kill-Do-" (Kiru-Do)
155.summary: A musical by K-MUSICAL PROJECT will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
155.body:
## Performance Overview

The musical "Kill-Do-" (Kiru-Do) by K-MUSICAL PROJECT will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Theater. The performance runs for two days, from Saturday, September 26, 2026 to Sunday, September 27, 2026, and is attracting attention as a new work in the musical genre.

Tickets are now on general sale following the Kokono Theater advance sale. The production is said to be characterized by powerful staging and high musical quality.

This is a rare opportunity to enjoy a musical in the Asakusa area, and audiences can look forward to an experience full of the immediacy unique to a theater. It is drawing interest from theater and music fans as a new challenge from K-MUSICAL PROJECT.

156.title: Mitsunori Fukuhara's "Itsuka Dokoka de" Workshop
156.summary: A workshop by Mitsunori Fukuhara, presented by the theater company Three Pilbergs, will be held at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
156.body:
## Mitsunori Fukuhara's "Itsuka Dokoka de" Workshop

At Asakusa Kokono Theater, "Mitsunori Fukuhara's Itsuka Dokoka de Workshop," organized by Three Pilbergs, will be held from September 28 to 30, 2026. It is a theater workshop-style event, and Kokono Theater advance tickets and general sale tickets are also available.

Mitsunori Fukuhara, known as a playwright and director, is expected to lead the sessions, making this a valuable learning opportunity for participants interested in theater.

Asakusa Kokono Theater actively hosts not only stage performances but also participatory events such as workshops, as part of its efforts to broaden the base of the local theater culture. The event runs for three days, and details are available on the official website.

157.title: Fantasy Magic Space Simbie Box "A Soaring Heart: The Story of Shokyokusai Tenkatsu"
157.summary: The third performance by Fantasy Magic Space Simbie Box will be held at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
157.body:
## Fantasy Magic Space Simbie Box "A Soaring Heart – The Story of Shokyokusai Tenkatsu"

"A Soaring Heart – The Story of Shokyokusai Tenkatsu," the third performance by "Fantasy Magic Space Simbie Box," will be staged at Asakusa Kokono Theater.

The performance runs for **three days, from Friday, October 9 to Sunday, October 11, 2026**. The series is known for stages that blend fantastical magic with storytelling. Based on the story of Shokyokusai Tenkatsu, a legendary magician, the production is expected to combine history and entertainment.

Tickets are now on general sale following the Kokono Theater presale. It is recommended not only for magic fans but also for audiences looking for a stage with a strong narrative. It can be called one of the performances that represent Asakusa's theater culture.

158.title: Uwanosora Toshiro Ichiza "Luna Rainbow"
158.summary: Uwanosora Toshiro Ichiza will stage the play "Luna Rainbow" at Asakusa Kokono Gekijo (Asakusa Kokonoge).
158.body:
## Uwanosora Toshiro Ichiza "Luna Rainbow"

The stage play "Luna Rainbow" by Uwanosora Toshiro Ichiza will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Gekijo from **October 14 to 18, 2026**.

The schedule from the Kokono Gekijo advance ticket sale through to the general sale has been announced, providing information for the troupe's fans.

The title "Luna Rainbow" suggests a fantastical, colorful stage, and the troupe's unique world view is expected to unfold.

The run lasts five days, which is relatively long, making it possible to see the show multiple times. Attention is also focused on the staging that makes use of the theater space at Asakusa Kokono Gekijo.

159.title: Yosei Daizukan "ASAKUSA THUNDER GATE"
159.summary: The stage production "ASAKUSA THUNDER GATE" by the theater company Yosei Daizukan will be held at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
159.body:
## Yosei Daizukan "ASAKUSA THUNDER GATE"

The theater company "Yosei Daizukan" will present "ASAKUSA THUNDER GATE" at Asakusa Kokono Theater (Asakusa Kokonoge) from **October 21 to 25, 2026**.

As the title, which features Asakusa as its theme, suggests, the production is expected to present a concept linked to the local area. Schedules for the Kokono Theater advance ticket sales and general sales have also been announced, building anticipation for the show.

During the five-day run, performances by multiple casts may be planned. Even within Asakusa Kokono Theater's distinctive lineup, this ambitious work that highlights local character is drawing attention.

160.title: One-Person Musical "BLACK BOX"
160.summary: The one-person musical "BLACK BOX" by Lunahana Theatre Company will be held at Asakusa Kokonoge (Asakusa Kokonoge Theater).
160.body:
## One-Person Musical "BLACK BOX"

The one-person musical "BLACK BOX" by Lunahana Theatre Company will be performed at Asakusa Kokonoge Theater for **5 days, from October 28 to November 1, 2026**.

Its distinctive, challenging format has a single performer handling both the singing and the acting, and a stage full of tension is expected.

Multiple performances are scheduled during the run, and ticket categories such as a Kokonoge presale and general sale are available.

As a piece that tests the performer's expressive power, it is attracting growing interest from theater fans. Staging that makes use of the compact space of Asakusa Kokonoge Theater is also one of the highlights.

161.title: The 19th Asakusa Lantern Festival
161.summary: An autumn tradition in which lanterns are lit around Asakusa Shrine will be held from October 19 to 26.
161.body:
## The 19th Asakusa Lantern Festival

The annual "Asakusa Lantern Festival," announced by the Asakusa Tourist Federation, marks its 19th year this year. It runs for one week, from **October 19 to 26, 2026**, with many lanterns lit from sunset until 21:30 within the grounds of Asakusa Shrine and the surrounding area.

The Senso-ji and Asakusa Shrine area is enveloped in magical light at night, delighting worshippers and tourists in this annual autumn event. Lanterns may also carry messages from local residents and sponsoring organizations, making it an event that conveys the bonds of the local community.

It is also popular as an evening stroll route and is known as a photo spot. Because the event is held only during the limited hours from sunset until 21:30, it is a good idea to check the sunset time before you visit. We recommend enjoying it together with a visit to Senso-ji.

162.title: Asakusa Geisha Ozashiki Dance, Autumn 2026
162.summary: An event featuring performances by Asakusa geisha, including hokan (traditional male entertainer) acts and ozashiki games, will be held at the Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center, mainly on autumn Saturdays.
162.body:
## Event Overview

"Asakusa Geisha Ozashiki Dance" will be held at the Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center for the autumn 2026 season.

The event takes place on Saturdays: **October 3, 17, 24, 31, and November 7, 14**. It is a valuable opportunity to see up close the traditional performing arts that live on in Asakusa's geisha district (hanamachi).

## Program

The program will include ozashiki dance, hokan (taikomochi) performances by a hokan entertainer, and a corner where visitors can experience ozashiki games themselves.

As it offers an easy way to enjoy the art of the geisha, usually seen only at banquet rooms (ozashiki), the event is popular not only with tourists but also with local fans. It is a rare opportunity for anyone who wants to experience Japanese traditional culture and the refined world of the hanamachi.

**Capacity limits may be set for each event date, so we recommend confirming details with the organizer.**

163.title: AUTUMN FAIR Scratch Card Campaign
163.summary: Get a scratch card for every ¥3,000 spent on shopping or dining at participating stores, and win ROX shopping/dining vouchers worth up to ¥5,000.

Asakusa ROX will hold the "AUTUMN FAIR Scratch Card Campaign" from September 11 to October 12, 2026. During the campaign period, customers receive one scratch card for every ¥3,000 (tax included, receipts cannot be combined) spent on shopping or dining at participating stores on the same day, and can win a "ROX Shopping/Dining Voucher" on the spot.

ROX Shopping/Dining Vouchers are valid until November 30, 2026, and become invalid after that date, so please be careful. Some stores and products, such as SEIYU Food Hall and Kura Sushi, are excluded. Please check the PDF guide for details.

164.title: September Basement Floor Schedule & Special Deals
164.summary: Matsuya Asakusa's basement (food floor) is offering special deals and event schedules for September.
164.body:
## September Basement Floor Schedule & Special Deals

From September 2 to September 29, 2026, the basement food floor at Matsuya Asakusa will feature monthly special-priced items and a schedule of events. Many products, mainly foods useful for everyday meals, are expected to be offered at bargain prices during the period.

The basement food section is a regular stop for shoppers in the Asakusa area, and its seasonal promotions have been well received. This time, too, the lineup is expected to reflect the arrival of autumn, and visitors can check out **daily and weekly special offers**.

Details on eligible products and discount rates are expected to be announced in-store and on the official website as they become available. It is also a great place to stop by while sightseeing or shopping in Asakusa.

165.title: Chopsticks Studio Asakusa, a Japanese Culture Experience Facility for International Visitors, Reportedly Set to Open
165.summary: There are reports that "Chopsticks Studio Asakusa," a multi-purpose Japanese culture experience facility for international visitors to Japan, will open in Asakusa.
165.body: Contents Like LLC is believed to be opening "Chopsticks Studio Asakusa," a multi-purpose Japanese culture experience facility for international visitors to Japan, in Asakusa. In recent years, as the number of international tourists visiting the Asakusa area has grown, demand for facilities where visitors can experience Japanese culture has increased, and this new facility is thought to be an initiative in line with that trend. Details of the experiences offered and the opening date are yet to be announced, but traditional cultural content such as kimono experiences, tea ceremony, and calligraphy may be offered. Asakusa is home to tourist attractions such as Kaminarimon and Senso-ji, and synergy with the surrounding area is also expected. As inbound demand recovers, demand for such experience-based facilities is expected to grow further. It is drawing attention as a topic that could also help enrich tourism content across the whole area.

166.title: Manzai Association's Mid-September Program Held at Asakusa Toyokan
166.summary: The Manzai Association's mid-September program is currently being held at Asakusa Toyokan.
166.body:
## Manzai Association's Mid-September Program Held at Asakusa Toyokan

At Asakusa Toyokan, performers belonging to the Manzai Association are appearing in the "Nakaseki" (middle ten-day program), a traditional division of the yose (variety theater) calendar. The venue is one of Asakusa's leading theaters devoted to performing arts, where you can enjoy a wide range of acts such as manzai, comedy sketches, and storytelling, with the lineup changing daily.

This Nakaseki runs **from September 11 to 19**, offering a valuable opportunity to experience the performing arts culture rooted in Asakusa.

Popular with local fans of the performing arts as well as tourists, the theater draws many visitors both day and night. It is also a cultural spot where you can easily drop in when visiting Asakusa.

Details of the program and ticket information are provided from time to time on the theater's official website.

167.title: Tokyo Engei Association's "Taryū Yose" Held at Asakusa Toyokan
167.summary: The Tokyo Engei Association's special event "Taryū Yose" will be held at Asakusa Toyokan on September 20.
167.body:
## Tokyo Engei Association's "Taryū Yose" Held at Asakusa Toyokan

Asakusa Toyokan will host the special performance "**Taryū Yose**," organized by the Tokyo Engei Association, for one day only on Sunday, September 20.

This special program differs from the regular middle and late 10-day programs, and its highlight is that multiple schools and performance styles come together under one roof. It is a rare opportunity to enjoy a wide range of entertainment at once, including rakugo, manzai, and iromono (variety acts), and it is attracting strong attention from fans of live variety performance.

As an event that could only be staged at Toyokan, a symbol of Asakusa's performing arts culture, it has been well received every year despite being a one-off performance.

If you wish to attend, checking the schedule in advance is recommended. It is also a good fit to drop in on while sightseeing in Asakusa.

168.title: Boys Variety Association's Late-September Program Held at Asakusa Toyokan
168.summary: From September 21 to 29, the Boys Variety Association's late-month program will be held at Asakusa Toyokan.
168.body:
## Boys Variety Association's Late-September Program Held at Asakusa Toyokan

From September 21 to 29, Asakusa Toyokan will host the Boys Variety Association's "Shimo-seki" (late-month program). Boys variety is a unique style of entertainment combining instrumental performances and comic storytelling, and is a beloved traditional art form at Toyokan.

During the run, member performers will present **a diverse lineup of acts that changes daily**, making it easy to enjoy even for first-time visitors to live variety entertainment. It is a valuable opportunity to experience traditional yose theater culture amid Asakusa's warm, old-town atmosphere.

Because the program runs for an extended period, many audience members visit multiple times to enjoy different acts. Detailed schedules of the acts are announced at the theater as they become available.

169.title: Boys Variety Association's "Special Selection Boys & Variety" to Be Held at Asakusa Toyokan
169.summary: A specially organized "Special Selection Boys & Variety" performance will be held at Asakusa Toyokan on September 30.
169.body:
## "Special Selection Boys & Variety" to Be Held at Asakusa Toyokan

A special performance by the Boys Variety Association, "Special Selection Boys & Variety," will be held for one day only on Wednesday, September 30, at Asakusa Toyokan.

Unlike the regular late-month (shimo-seki) run, this is planned as a special program gathering hand-picked performers and acts, condensing the appeal of the boys-variety genre.

**The unique entertainment style that combines instrumental performances, comedy sketches, and manzai-style monologues** is very popular and is one of Toyokan's signature shows. Because this is a one-off performance, visitors are encouraged to check the schedule in advance before attending.

It is drawing attention as an easy-to-enjoy entertainment experience to drop in on while strolling around Asakusa.

170.title: K-MUSICAL PROJECT "Kill-Do-" (キル-道-)
170.summary: The musical "Kill-Do-" (キル-道-) by K-MUSICAL PROJECT will be staged for two days at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
170.body:
## K-MUSICAL PROJECT "Kill-Do-" (キル-道-)

The musical "Kill-Do-" (キル-道-) by K-MUSICAL PROJECT will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Theater (浅草九劇) from **September 26 to 27, 2026**.

The company, which has drawn attention as a musical project from Korea, is known for its distinctive musical style and dynamic staging, and this production is also expected to be a spectacular show.

The performances are limited to two weekend days, with multiple ticket categories, including a Kokono Theater presale and general sales. It is recommended for musical fans as well as first-time theatergoers.

You can enjoy a powerful stage in the charming theater space of Asakusa Kokono Theater, located in the heart of the city. **Please note that tickets may sell out early.**

171.title: Star Festival (Hoshi Kuyo-e / Hoshi Matsuri)
171.summary: A Buddhist memorial service for the stars, held in the Main Hall on the day of the winter solstice.
171.body:
## Star Festival (Hoshi Kuyo-e / Hoshi Matsuri)

On the day of the winter solstice, Senso-ji Temple holds the "Star Festival (Hoshi Kuyo-e / Hoshi Matsuri)" in the Main Hall. The festival is a traditional event in which people make offerings to their own honmyosei (the guardian star corresponding to one's birth year) and pray for good health and protection from misfortune throughout the year.

Because it is held on the winter solstice, the day with the shortest daylight of the year, it also carries **the meaning of praying for the shift from yin to yang**.

In the Main Hall, prayers are offered to the stars along with sutra chanting by the monks, and visitors can quietly watch the ceremony. In an Asakusa that grows busier as the end of the year approaches, it is an opportunity to calm the mind and make wishes for the new year.

172.title: The 60th Anniversary Recommended Master Dance Festival (Suisen Meiryu Buyo Taikai)
172.summary: The traditional Master Dance Festival will be held at Asakusa Public Hall on September 5.
172.body: The "60th Anniversary Recommended Master Dance Festival" will be held at Asakusa Public Hall. Organized by the Cultural Projects Department, Tokyo Shimbun Business Bureau, this traditional dance festival marks its milestone 60th edition. Doors open at 12:30 and the performance begins at 13:00, with a long program scheduled to end at 20:30. Advance tickets are 7,000 yen and same-day tickets are 7,500 yen, with all seats unreserved. Performers who embody the essence of Japanese classical dance will take the stage, making this a locally noted event and an opportunity to experience traditional culture. For inquiries, please contact the Cultural Projects Department, Tokyo Shimbun Business Bureau.

173.title: Gap Asakusa ROX Store to Open on September 18
173.summary: MARUGap will open "Gap Asakusa ROX," its first store in the Asakusa area, on Friday, September 18.
173.body:
## Gap Asakusa ROX Store to Open on September 18

MARUGap Co., Ltd., which operates the apparel brand "Gap," will **open "Gap Asakusa ROX" on Friday, September 18**, its first store in the Asakusa area.

Asakusa ROX is a mixed-use commercial complex in the Asakusa area that is popular with local residents and tourists. A new store opening there is drawing attention as news that could also help revitalize commerce in the area.

Gap is a global brand from the United States that focuses on casual wear and is supported by a wide range of age groups. Because there have been few large apparel chain stores in the Asakusa area until now, expectations are growing locally for it to become a new shopping spot.

Sales or campaigns may be held on opening day, and further details are awaited. The store is also expected to encourage visitors to explore more of the area and to have a positive ripple effect on the local economy.

174.title: Engawa SUMIDA Japanese French Dining Asakusa Kaminarimon Now Open
174.summary: Engawa SUMIDA Japanese French Dining Asakusa Kaminarimon, a new dining concept blending Japanese and French cuisine, opened on September 7, 2026, just a 1-minute walk from Asakusa Station.
174.body:
## Engawa SUMIDA Japanese French Dining Asakusa Kaminarimon Now Open

A new dining venue, "Engawa SUMIDA Japanese French Dining Asakusa Kaminarimon," opened on September 7, 2026, in a prime location just a 1-minute walk from Asakusa Station (Tobu, Toei, and Metro lines).

The modern space faces the Sumida River and offers panoramic views of sights such as the Skytree. Terrace seating is also available.

The menu features a unique style combining Japanese and French cuisine. One of the signature dishes, **"Salmon Noodle 3.0,"** is served under supervision, offering rich dishes in both appearance and flavor. Halal options are also available, catering to a wide range of tourists. The restaurant can also be used as a ramen shop or a dining bar, with a menu that crosses genres.

Reviews praise the view of the Skytree and the high quality of the food. It looks set to become a new option for those looking for sightseeing spots or places to eat in Asakusa.

175.title: Ito Shiro Ichiza Returns!? at Asakusa Public Hall
175.summary: Screenings of two early works by Ito Shiro Ichiza, plus a hilarious talk event featuring Ito, Miyake and Azuma, will be held at Asakusa Public Hall.
175.body: An event titled "Ito Shiro Ichiza Returns!?" will be held at Asakusa Public Hall. Two early works by Ito Shiro Ichiza will be screened, and a talk show with Mr. Ito, Mr. Miyake and Mr. Azuma will also take place. The program is designed to be enjoyed not only by longtime fans of classic comedy sketches but also by people of all generations. For inquiries and ticket purchases, contact Ticket Space. It looks to be a valuable opportunity to experience Asakusa's traditional performing arts culture.

176.title: The 41st Kappabashi Dogu Matsuri (Kappabashi Kitchen Town Festival)
176.summary: The annual Kappabashi Dogu Matsuri will be held from October 6 to 12 in Kappabashi Kitchen Town, where you can find cookware, tableware, and more.
176.body:
The annual "Kappabashi Dogu Matsuri" will be held again this year in Kappabashi Kitchen Town, known for offering every kind of tool related to food, including cookware, tableware, and knives.

The 41st festival will run from October 6 to 12, 2026. Shops throughout the town will offer special prices and sales, and events unique to Kappabashi Kitchen Town are also planned.

Popular not only with professional chefs and restaurant owners but also with general visitors and international travelers, it is a rare opportunity to pick up and choose from the many tools that support Japan's food culture.

Within walking distance of Senso-ji Temple and Kaminarimon, the area is also easy to combine with your Asakusa sightseeing.

The whole town becomes lively during the festival, so visiting early in the day is the key to browsing at a relaxed pace.

177.title: The 19th Asakusa Toro Festival (Lantern Festival)
177.summary: The Asakusa Toro Festival, when lanterns are lit around Asakusa Shrine, runs from September 19 to 26.
177.body:
The 19th Asakusa Toro Festival (Lantern Festival) has begun, with lantern light brightening the streets of Asakusa, centered on Asakusa Shrine, from sunset until 21:30.

Held each year from the end of summer into autumn, the festival has become a well-established tradition. Lanterns lining the shrine grounds and surrounding streets create a magical atmosphere. Its appeal lies in the distinctive charm of Asakusa at night, which is different from the bustle of the daytime.

The festival runs for one week, from September 19 to 26, 2026, with the lanterns lit from sunset until 21:30. It is a good time to stop by to round off a day of sightseeing in Asakusa, or on your way home from work.

Coming just after major summer events such as the Asakusa Samba Carnival and the Kaminarimon Bon Odori, the festival is loved by locals as an event that quietly signals the arrival of autumn. It is also a popular photo spot, and this is the season when more posts appear on social media.

178.title: <Leonartjewelry> <Oksana> Pop-up Store
178.summary: A pop-up store featuring jewelry brands will be held at the women's accessories promotional space at Matsuya Asakusa.
178.body:
## <Leonartjewelry> <Oksana> Pop-up Store

A limited-time pop-up store featuring "Leonartjewelry" and "Oksana" will be held at the women's accessories promotional space at Matsuya Asakusa. Accessories and jewelry from both brands will be on offer, allowing visitors to pick up and choose from uniquely designed items that are not easy to find elsewhere.

As the event takes place over a period that includes a public holiday, it is a good time to look for a gift or a treat for yourself. Held in a sales area that is easy to stop by when visiting Matsuya Asakusa, it looks to be an event not to be missed by customers who love women's accessories.

**Dates**: One week only, from September 23 to 29.

179.title: Asakusa Takumi Masterpieces Exhibition
179.summary: The "Asakusa Takumi Masterpieces Exhibition" is now being held at Space of Asakusa, bringing together fine items showcasing the craftsmanship of Asakusa's artisans.
179.body:
The "Asakusa Takumi Masterpieces Exhibition" is being held at "Space of Asakusa" in Matsuya Asakusa, presenting carefully crafted items made by local Asakusa artisans.

Asakusa has long been known as a town of artisans, an area where a wide range of skills, from traditional crafts to modern manufacturing, have been passed down. This exhibition brings together masterpieces that showcase this "master craftsmanship."

It is a rare opportunity to pick up and choose items unique to Asakusa that are hard to come across in everyday life.

The exhibition runs from Wednesday, September 16 to Tuesday, September 29, 2026. It is also recommended for those who want to rediscover the charm of the local area through an exhibition where you can experience Asakusa's artisan culture.

180.title: Kimono Photo Shoot at Asakusa Hanayashiki: Limited-Time "Asakusa Kimono Photo Plan"
180.summary: Kimono rental wargo has launched a limited-time plan in which a professional photographer photographs you in a kimono at Asakusa Hanayashiki.
180.body: Kimono rental wargo is offering a limited-time kimono photo plan with a professional photographer, set at Asakusa Hanayashiki. Against the backdrop of Asakusa Hanayashiki, an amusement park full of old-downtown (shitamachi) charm, visitors can enjoy commemorative photos in kimono. Aimed at international visitors to Japan and people interested in kimono culture, the plan proposes a new way to enjoy sightseeing in Asakusa. The photos can be received as digital data, so they can be kept as memories of your trip. Asakusa Hanayashiki is also known as Japan's oldest amusement park, and its retro atmosphere pairs well with kimono, which led to this collaboration. Because the plan is limited-time, the exact period and how to make a reservation need to be confirmed through official information. This initiative is also drawing attention as tourism content for the Asakusa area.

181.title: Comprehensive Small Bird & Small Animal Event "Trip & Peace in Asakusa" to Be Held
181.summary: Chronos Co., Ltd. will hold a comprehensive event themed around small birds and small animals in Asakusa.
181.body: "Trip & Peace in Asakusa" (Torippu & Peez in Asakusa), a comprehensive event where visitors can interact with small birds and small animals, will be held. Organized by Chronos Co., Ltd., the event is planned as a gathering of exhibitions, merchandise sales, and hands-on experience booths featuring birds and small animals. It is designed to be enjoyed not only by enthusiasts who keep small birds and small animals, but also by families and tourists, and, making use of the Asakusa location, it expects visitors from both Japan and abroad. The venue is expected to include areas where visitors can interact with small animals in person and merchandise booths run by specialty shops, and it will also serve as a place to buy pet-related goods and gather information. Details on the date, time, and venue must be confirmed through official announcements. In recent years, experiential and themed pop-up events like this have been increasing in the Asakusa area.

182.title: "Initial D" Pop-Up Store Opens at Asakusa ROX, Featuring a Life-Size Display of Takumi Fujiwara
182.summary: Starting September 18, CAMSHOP.JP will hold an "Initial D" pop-up store at Asakusa ROX, with items such as a life-size panel of Takumi Fujiwara and other related merchandise.
182.body:
## "Initial D" Pop-Up Store Opens at Asakusa ROX, Featuring a Life-Size Display of Takumi Fujiwara

CAMSHOP.JP, operated by FACE Co., Ltd., will hold a pop-up store themed on the popular manga and anime "Initial D" at Asakusa ROX starting September 18, 2026.

The venue will feature a life-size panel of the protagonist, Takumi Fujiwara, and will sell merchandise, apparel, collaboration items and more related to the series.

"Initial D" has a devoted fan base as a work depicting the mountain-pass street racing culture, and holding the event in the Asakusa area is a rare opportunity for fans.

In recent years, Asakusa ROX has increasingly been used as a venue for pop-up events featuring anime and character collaborations, helping to attract young people and tourists.

For details such as the event period and business hours, please check the official announcement.

183.title: Long-Established Asakusa Imagawayaki Shop "Tsuki no Usagi," Known for Its Premium Sweet Bean Paste, to Open Its First Wakayama Store
183.summary: Tsuki no Usagi, a popular Asakusa imagawayaki shop founded in 1950 that sells 3,000 pieces a day, will open its first store in Wakayama.
183.body: Tsuki no Usagi, a leading imagawayaki shop in Asakusa, has announced that it will open its first store in Wakayama Prefecture. Founded in 1950 (Showa 25), the long-established shop is best known for its imagawayaki filled with premium sweet bean paste (anko) that has been handed down through the generations. The Asakusa main store sells about 3,000 pieces a day, and it is a famous spot where long lines are not unusual. With the new Wakayama store, more fans in the Kansai region will have a chance to enjoy the taste of Asakusa. The opening is thought to aim at expanding into a new region while preserving Asakusa's traditional methods and flavor. Although similar sweets can be found throughout Japan, the high quality of the bean paste, made possible by the shop's long history, is its strength. The opening is drawing attention as an opportunity for an Asakusa specialty to gain nationwide recognition.

184.title: Bicycle Parking Restrictions Due to Exterior Wall Work
184.summary: Bicycle parking areas at the Asakusa ROX main building will be restricted in stages due to exterior wall work.
184.body:
Asakusa ROX has announced that, in order to carry out exterior wall work on its main building, it will temporarily restrict the use of its bicycle parking areas as temporary fencing is installed in stages.

During the construction period, some bicycle parking spaces on the premises will be reduced or unavailable, so visitors who come by bicycle are expected to be affected.

The facility is directing visitors arriving by bicycle to the bicycle parking area on the **ROX-3G rooftop** as an alternative.

No specific end date for the work has been announced, but it is scheduled to proceed in stages, and caution is needed until it is completed.

Local residents and tourists who regularly use Asakusa ROX may want to check where to park their bicycles before visiting.

185.title: Asakusa Kokono Geki Kaiwai #0 "Actor Solo Projects Kaiwai" Announced
185.summary: The first installment of a new talk event series set at Asakusa Kokono Geki, "Actor Solo Projects Kaiwai," has been announced as "Asakusa Kokono Geki Kaiwai #0."
185.body:
"Actor Solo Projects Kaiwai" has been announced as the landmark episode #0 of **"Asakusa Kokono Geki Kaiwai,"** a new talk event series based at the Asakusa theater **Asakusa Kokono Geki**.

This event focuses on solo projects that stage actors produce themselves, exploring the behind-the-scenes work and the thoughts behind them in a talk format. It is attracting attention from theater fans and industry professionals.

In recent years, Asakusa Kokono Geki has become an increasingly prominent hub for theater and entertainment, and this talk event was planned as part of those activities.

Being positioned as episode #0 suggests the possibility of it becoming a series, and it is expected to be an initiative that shows the growing reach of theater culture in the Asakusa area. For details on the date, time and ticket information, please await further announcements from the organizer, Repro Entertainment Co., Ltd..

186.title: BEAMS JAPAN to Open a Limited-Time Store in Asakusa
186.summary: To coincide with the opening of a permanent BEAMS JAPAN store in Kotohira, Kagawa on October 31, limited-time stores will also open in Asakusa and Hakone.
186.body:
BEAMS Inc. has announced a new expansion of its select shop "BEAMS JAPAN." In addition to a permanent store opening in Kotohira, Kagawa Prefecture on October 31, the company will also open limited-time stores in Asakusa and Hakone.

BEAMS JAPAN is known as a select shop that introduces traditional crafts and local brands from across Japan, and it has been actively expanding into tourist destinations. Asakusa is an area visited by many tourists from Japan and overseas, and the limited-time store will add a new option for Asakusa souvenirs.

Additional information on the specific period and location of the store is expected to be announced. It is an initiative drawing attention as a store expansion in the Asakusa area.

Against the backdrop of a rise in international visitors to Japan, pop-up and limited-time stores have been opening one after another in the Asakusa area, and this BEAMS JAPAN opening is thought to be part of that trend.

187.title: Otakara At Market Opens Its First Store for Foreign Visitors to Japan in Asakusa
187.summary: Otakara At Market, operated by Woodstock Co., Ltd., has opened its first store aimed at foreign visitors to Japan in Asakusa.
187.body:
Woodstock Co., Ltd. has announced that it has opened the first store for foreign visitors to Japan of its reuse and buyback shop "Otakara At Market" in the Asakusa area.

Asakusa is an area visited by many tourists from Japan and overseas, and stores are needed that meet the purchasing demand of foreign tourists visiting Japan. The new store is believed to have strengthened services for visitors to Japan, such as tax-free shopping and multilingual support.

In the reuse industry as well, store openings targeting tourists visiting Japan have been increasing in recent years, and Asakusa has been drawing attention as an area thanks to its excellent location.

With this opening, the number of stores that further meet shopping demand in the Asakusa area will increase.

188.title: Reservations Open September 17 for "KOKO HOTEL Residence Asakusa Nitenmon"
188.summary: Reservations have opened for the new accommodation "KOKO HOTEL Residence Asakusa Nitenmon" starting September 17.
188.body:
Ides announced that it began accepting reservations on September 17, 2026, for its new accommodation, "KOKO HOTEL Residence Asakusa Nitenmon."

Nitenmon is known as one of the gates of Senso-ji Temple, and the area is conveniently accessible for tourists. The newly opening property is a "residence"-type accommodation and is believed to be equipped with facilities suited to extended stays.

As the number of international visitors to Japan grows, new hotels and residence-type accommodations continue to open one after another in the Asakusa area. The arrival of a new property in the Asakusa Nitenmon area can be seen as a reflection of rising local demand for accommodation.

Along with the start of reservations, details of the opening schedule and accommodation plans are expected to be announced in the future.

189.title: First-Ever Event at Senso-ji Temple to Showcase the "Now" of 12 Municipalities in Fukushima's Hamadori Region
189.summary: "Discover Fukushima," an event promoting the appeal of the 12 municipalities of Fukushima Prefecture's Hamadori region, will be held for the first time on the grounds of Senso-ji Temple.
189.body:
Space One Co., Ltd. has announced that it will hold "Discover Fukushima," an event showcasing the "now" of the 12 municipalities in Fukushima Prefecture's Hamadori region, on the grounds of Senso-ji Temple for the first time.

Senso-ji Temple is an iconic spot in the Asakusa area, visited by many worshippers and tourists from Japan and abroad every year, and holding a regional promotion event there carries great power to spread the word.

Fukushima Prefecture's Hamadori region is an area where recovery from the Great East Japan Earthquake is progressing, and various initiatives are being carried out to share the current situation and appeal of the region. At this event, the specialty products, tourism information, and recovery progress of each of the 12 municipalities are expected to be introduced.

By holding the event in Asakusa, a location with such strong outreach power, it is hoped that the appeal of Fukushima will reach even more people.

190.title: ZAKU KNIVES Offers Tax-Free Shopping and Name Engraving in Asakusa
190.summary: ZAKU KNIVES, a knife brand operated by ICHIGO Co., Ltd., is meeting the souvenir demand of international visitors to Japan in Asakusa through tax-free shopping and name engraving services.
190.body:
ICHIGO Co., Ltd. has announced that its ZAKU KNIVES store in Asakusa will strengthen its response to souvenir demand from international visitors to Japan through tax-free shopping and a name engraving service.

Japanese knives are popular souvenirs among visitors to Japan thanks to their high quality, and the Asakusa area is drawing attention as a place to buy them. The name engraving service also adds value as an original souvenir tailored to each individual visitor.

Enhancing tax-free support is a measure that encourages international visitors to make purchases, and it is one of the initiatives that stores in the Asakusa area are competing to introduce.

With this rollout, international visitors to Asakusa will have even more options when choosing souvenirs.

191.title: Asakusa-Born "THE SQUARE BURGER" Earns a High 4.9 Rating on Google Reviews
191.summary: Asakusa-born burger shop "THE SQUARE BURGER" has received over 2,000 Google reviews with a 4.9 rating, and is gaining popularity among international visitors to Japan.
191.body:
Cool Japan TV Co., Ltd. announced that "THE SQUARE BURGER," a burger specialty restaurant that originated in Asakusa, has earned a high rating of 4.9 from more than 2,000 reviews on Google.

The restaurant operates in the Asakusa area. It enjoys strong support from international visitors to Japan, and its reputation has spread through social media and review sites.

Asakusa attracts visitors not only with its traditional tourist attractions but also with the buzz around restaurants like this one, and its presence as an area offering diverse culinary experiences is growing.

It is believed that the high ratings reflect not only the quality of the food and service, but also the restaurant's ability to accommodate international tourists.

192.title: Asakusa Kugeki Neighborhood (Asakusa Kugeki Kaiwai)
192.summary: The event "Asakusa Kugeki Kaiwai" will be held for one day only at Asakusa Kugeki.
192.body:
An event titled "Asakusa Kugeki Kaiwai" will be held at Asakusa Kugeki.

The detailed program is not disclosed on the page, but tickets are being sold through a Kugeki presale and a general sale, suggesting that it is an event where fans and performers gathering at the theater can interact.

It is drawing attention as a one-day-only event where you can enjoy the atmosphere unique to Asakusa Kugeki.

193.title: and ST "Double Points Campaign"
193.summary: and ST is holding a double points campaign exclusively for members. It's a great chance to save on your autumn shopping.
193.body:
At "and ST" on the 1st floor of Asakusa ROX, an "All Points Double Campaign" exclusively for and ST members is being held from Saturday, September 19 to Wednesday, September 23 (national holiday).

Timed with Silver Week, members earn double points not only on autumn clothing but also on everyday items.

Please note that some items are excluded, so we recommend checking in advance. Details on eligible items and the latest campaign information are updated regularly on the official and ST social media account (@andst_official).

Why not pick up your autumn fashion and style essentials all at once at and ST during this campaign?

194.title: AMERICAN HOLIC Launches Items Inspired by "Where's Wally?"
194.summary: AMERICAN HOLIC on the 2nd floor of Asakusa ROX is offering limited-time collaboration items inspired by the popular picture book "Where's Wally?".
194.body:
Special items inspired by the picture book favorite "Where's Wally?" are now available at "AMERICAN HOLIC" on the 2nd floor of Asakusa ROX.

The event runs from Friday, September 18 to Wednesday, September 23 (national holiday). In September, the whole store is offering plenty of content you can enjoy together with Wally, making it fun for fans as well as those who aren't usually familiar with Wally.

Details on the product lineup and other offerings will be updated from time to time on the AMERICAN HOLIC official website.

Be sure to check out these collaboration items, which blend nostalgia with novelty, at the store.

195.title: Edo Cuisine Restaurant Sakurada Officially Launches "Edo Breakfast"
195.summary: Sakurada, an Edo cuisine restaurant in Asakusa, has officially begun serving its new "Edo Breakfast" menu, themed around the breakfast culture of the Edo period.
195.body:
Sakurada, a restaurant specializing in Edo cuisine in Asakusa, has officially launched a new program called **"Edo Breakfast" (Edo no Asameshi)**, built around the concept of "starting your day in Asakusa."

The restaurant, which passes on the food culture of the Edo period to the present day, has given a modern twist to the breakfast dishes said to have been enjoyed by ordinary people and townspeople of that era. The menu is designed to help travelers and local customers start their day in Asakusa on a pleasant note.

Asakusa is a tourist destination, and many visitors struggle to choose a restaurant for the morning hours. The program is expected to appeal to those looking for a traditional Japanese breakfast experience.

Enjoyed inside a restaurant that evokes the atmosphere of Edo, "Edo Breakfast" has the potential to become a new staple of Asakusa sightseeing. For details on the menu and serving hours, we recommend checking with the restaurant.

196.title: Asakusa Kokono Geki Kaiwai #0 "Actor-Led Solo Projects Kaiwai"
196.summary: "Actor-Led Solo Projects Kaiwai #0" will be held at Asakusa Kokono Geki, featuring a performance planned by individual actors.
196.body:
At Asakusa Kokono Geki, "Asakusa Kokono Geki Kaiwai #0 'Actor-Led Solo Projects Kaiwai'" will be staged as the 0th installment of a series of performances planned by individual actors.

This project, which is drawing attention as a performance conceived and planned by the actors themselves, beyond the boundaries of theater affiliation, offers a stage with a different approach from regular theater company productions.

The performance takes place for one day only, on September 22, 2026, and multiple ticket sales categories are available, including Kokono Geki advance sales and general sales.

As an initiative embodying the small-theater culture of the Asakusa area, it is recommended not only for theater fans but also for audiences who want to discover new talent.

197.title: Announcement: Construction of Jissha Gongen Shrine
197.summary: It has been announced that a new "Jissha Gongen Shrine" will be built on the grounds of Asakusa Shrine.
197.body:
It has been announced that a new "Jissha Gongen Shrine" will be built on the grounds of Asakusa Shrine.

The Jissha Gongen Shrine is said to enshrine together deities associated with Gongen worship from various regions, and is planned as part of the redevelopment project of the Asakusa Shrine grounds. Details such as the completion date and the content of ceremonies are expected to be announced by the shrine in due course.

Asakusa Shrine is popularly known as "Sanja-sama" and has long been revered as the guardian shrine of Asakusa. The construction of this Gongen shrine is also regarded as one of the efforts to carry on the history and faith of the local community.

For worshippers and local residents, this will add a new attraction to the grounds, and its completion is eagerly awaited.

198.title: Hanayashiki Hosts a "Hands-Free Halloween" Event
198.summary: Asakusa Hanayashiki will hold a hands-free Halloween event featuring costume rentals and a participatory parade.
198.body:
Asakusa Hanayashiki will hold an event themed "Hands-Free Halloween." In addition to a rental attraction that lets visitors join in easily even if they don't have a costume, a participatory parade will be held in which visitors can take part in costume.

In recent years, preparing a costume has often been a hurdle to joining Halloween events. This event is distinctive in that, by using a rental service, visitors can enjoy dressing up whenever the mood strikes. A wide range of visitors is expected, including families, couples, and groups of friends.

As the oldest amusement park in Japan, Asakusa Hanayashiki actively holds seasonal events that make the most of its retro atmosphere, and this Halloween event is part of that effort. The parade also offers the fun of showing off costumes to fellow visitors, and it is likely to draw attention as a photo spot that looks great on social media.

Details on the event period and how to participate are expected to be announced on the official website and elsewhere.

199.title: Keiichi Yamamoto and Miki Nishino to Hold LIVE at Raiden 5656 Kaikan Tokiwa Hall on Their Wedding Anniversary
199.summary: Comedians Keiichi Yamamoto and Miki Nishino will hold a LIVE at Tokiwa Hall in Raiden 5656 Kaikan in Asakusa to celebrate their 4th wedding anniversary.
199.body:
It has been announced that **Keiichi Yamamoto** and **Miki Nishino**, a married couple affiliated with Yoshimoto Kogyo, will hold a LIVE at Tokiwa Hall inside Raiden 5656 Kaikan in Asakusa to coincide with their 4th wedding anniversary.

This rare event features the couple on stage together, with talk looking back on their married life, performances and more planned. It will be a valuable opportunity for fans to celebrate this special anniversary with them.

Raiden 5656 Kaikan, the venue, is a multi-purpose complex located along Kaminarimon-dori in Asakusa. Tokiwa Hall is one of Asakusa's popular venues, hosting a wide range of events including rakugo, variety entertainment and live events.

Announcements regarding the specific date, time and ticket information are expected from Yoshimoto Kogyo and the venue's official channels. The event is drawing attention as a homey stage where the couple's bond can be felt.

200.title: Asakusa Autumn Thank-You Festival
200.summary: An autumn thank-you festival held from the basement to the 3rd floor of Matsuya Asakusa. Multiple events, including special sales of wristwatches and eyeglasses, will be held at the same time.
200.body:
Matsuya Asakusa will hold the "Asakusa Autumn Thank-You Festival" for two days, from Friday, September 25 to Saturday, September 26, 2026.

The venue spans multiple floors from the basement to the 3rd floor, with special promotions throughout the store as a token of thanks for customers' everyday patronage.

At the same time, specialty limited-time events will also be held in the event space, including the **Wristwatch Special Sale** and the **Tokyo Megane Special Sale**, offering chances to find items not usually available and to buy at special prices.

For those planning to shop or go out in the Asakusa area, this is a traditional autumn event that can be enjoyed in a short, concentrated period.

Since the event runs for only two days, if you are thinking of visiting, we recommend checking the schedule early.

201.title: Mu-Certified! Nostalgic Rumors Turn Hanayashiki into a Haunted Amusement Park
201.summary: An event themed on Showa-era urban legends is being held at Asakusa Hanayashiki, drawing attention as a collaboration with the occult magazine Mu.
201.body:
An event titled "Mu-Certified! Nostalgic Rumors Turn Hanayashiki into a Haunted Amusement Park," themed on urban legends and eerie rumors that were popular in the Showa era, will be held at the Asakusa amusement park Asakusa Hanayashiki.

The event is produced under the supervision and certification of Mu, a magazine known for its focus on the occult and urban legends. Inside Hanayashiki, with its retro Showa atmosphere, visitors can experience the world of ghost stories and rumors that were passed down in those days.

Hanayashiki is known as Japan's oldest amusement park, and its retro rides and atmosphere make it a natural setting for evoking both "fear" and "nostalgia." Ahead of the Halloween season, the event is expected to appeal not only to families and young people, but also to adult visitors who feel nostalgic for the atmosphere of the Showa era.

For details on the park's decorations and event presentation, please check the official announcements as they are released.

202.title: SHiZUKU Christmas Special 2026: Solo Live at Asakusa Hana Gekijo
202.summary: SHiZUKU will hold "Christmas Special 2026" at Asakusa Hana Gekijo, including the long-awaited first solo live show.
202.body:
"SHiZUKU Christmas Special 2026" by SHiZUKU, an artist signed to Repro Entertainment, has been announced. The venue is Asakusa Hana Gekijo, and it will be the artist's long-awaited first solo live show.

Special staging and a set list fitting the Christmas season are expected. With the concert taking place in Asakusa, a venue full of old downtown (shitamachi) atmosphere, it looks set to be a special night for fans.

In recent years, Asakusa Hana Gekijo has also drawn attention as a live venue for up-and-coming artists, and this performance can be seen as symbolic of that trend.

Ticket information and performance details are scheduled to be announced later, and the news is already generating buzz among fans.

203.title: Perfume Brand "Hatenko" Carrying Asakusa's History Makes Its First Appearance at Isetan Shinjuku
203.summary: "Hatenko," a perfume brand blending tradition and innovation on the theme of Asakusa's history, will make its first appearance at Isetan Shinjuku's "Salon de Parfum."
203.body:
Carry Innovate Co., Ltd. has announced that its perfume brand "Hatenko" will make its first appearance at Isetan Shinjuku's event "Salon de Parfum 2026."

"Hatenko" is known as a brand that captures Asakusa's history and cultural background in its fragrances, and is characterized by a concept that fuses tradition with innovation. This debut at Isetan Shinjuku offers a chance for a brand from Asakusa to attract attention at a department store event in central Tokyo.

With an item symbolizing Asakusa's culture and history being introduced at a large event outside the local area, it is expected to help convey the charm of Asakusa to a new audience.

Details on the exhibition period and the products on sale are scheduled to be announced at a later date.

204.title: Jissha Gongen Shrine Built on the Grounds of Asakusa Shrine
204.summary: It has been announced that a new "Jissha Gongen Shrine" has been built as part of the grounds improvement project at Asakusa Shrine.
204.body:
Asakusa Shrine has announced that it has built a new "Jissha Gongen Shrine" as part of its project to maintain the shrine buildings and improve the grounds. The initiative is drawing attention as an effort to further enhance the historical and religious value of the grounds.

Asakusa Shrine has long focused on maintaining its shrine buildings and improving its grounds, and the construction of this Gongen shrine is positioned as part of those efforts. For the shrine, which has long been rooted in the local community as the guardian shrine of Asakusa, a new attraction on its grounds is welcome news for worshippers and tourists alike.

Details on the background of the construction and the history of the Jissha Gongen Shrine are available on the detail page of the official website. When you visit Asakusa Shrine, which stands alongside Senso-ji as a symbol of Asakusa, why not pay your respects here as well?

205.title: ROX Fitness Club begin "Autumn Triple ZERO Campaign"
205.summary: ROX Fitness Club begin is running the "Autumn Triple ZERO Campaign" through October 30, waiving the enrollment fee, administration fee and monthly fee.
205.body:
ROX Fitness Club begin, located on the 8th and 9th floors of Asakusa ROX, is holding the "Autumn Triple ZERO Campaign" through Friday, October 30.

Timed for the season that's perfect for starting to exercise, the campaign greatly lowers the barrier to joining.

**Benefits**
- No enrollment fee; no administration fee; one month of monthly fees free
- Join in September and the September fee is also free
- Hydrogen water server, protein server and free pass free for 2 months (*requires 6 months of membership from enrollment)

It's a great chance for anyone worried about not getting enough exercise, or who wants to start a new habit.

For detailed conditions and terms of use, please check the official website of ROX Fitness Club begin.

206.title: Hands-Free Halloween at Hanayashiki: Costume Rental and Participatory Parade
206.summary: Asakusa Hanayashiki will hold a "hands-free Halloween" event featuring a costume rental attraction and a participatory parade.
206.body:
Asakusa Hanayashiki will hold a Halloween event this year under the concept of "Halloween you can enjoy hands-free."

A new "Costume Rental Attraction" will let visitors easily dress up without preparing their own outfits. A participatory parade will also be held, in which visitors can join in their costumes.

As a result, everyone from small children to adults can fully enjoy the Halloween spirit without the hassle of advance preparation. As a traditional autumn event at Hanayashiki, it usually draws many visitors every year.

The event offers a unique atmosphere that blends Asakusa's old-town charm with the otherworldly feel of Halloween, and photo spots that look great on social media are expected to be prepared as well.

During the event period, the park's decorations are also scheduled to be changed to a Halloween theme, and families and couples are expected to visit.

207.title: "Egao Plus Parent-Child Cafeteria" to Be Held at Asakusa Asaichi for Single-Parent Families
207.summary: A cafeteria event offering single-parent families a chance to eat their fill will be held at the Asakusa restaurant Asakusa Asaichi.
207.body:
It has been announced that the [Egao Plus Parent-Child Cafeteria], run by the Egao Plus Children Support Association (a general incorporated association), will be held at the restaurant "Asakusa Asaichi" in the Asakusa area.

This initiative is a support activity aimed at letting single-parent families, who may have difficulty getting enough to eat due to financial circumstances and other reasons, enjoy a warm meal until they are full. By using a locally rooted restaurant as the venue, it offers children an opportunity to enjoy a meal with peace of mind in a familiar place.

Such child support and food support initiatives are spreading across Japan, and a notable feature of this event in the Asakusa area is that it is carried out through cooperation between a local shop and partner organizations. For details such as the specific date and time and how to apply, please check the announcement from the organizer.

It is hoped that interest in and cooperation with this kind of support activity will grow among local residents and nearby businesses.

208.title: Yosei Daizukan (Fairy Encyclopedia)
208.summary: The stage play "Yosei Daizukan (Fairy Encyclopedia)" will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Geki.
208.body:
The stage play "Yosei Daizukan (Fairy Encyclopedia)" will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Geki.

The production brings a fantasy world inspired by fairies to the stage, and is expected to feature strongly fantasy-flavored staging. Ticket sales are offered in several steps, from a Kokono Geki presale through to general sale.

The performance period is from Wednesday, October 21 to Sunday, October 25, 2026. Enjoy a fantastical theater experience in the Asakusa area this autumn.

209.title: Discover Fukushima Hamadori 2026 Held at Senso-ji for the First Time
209.summary: Food, local products and cultural experiences from 12 municipalities in Fukushima's Hamadori region will gather at the plaza west of the Senso-ji main hall. Free admission, on Saturday, September 26 and Sunday, September 27.
209.body:
"Discover Fukushima Hamadori 2026," an event showcasing the "now" of the 12 municipalities of Fukushima's Hamadori region, will be held on two days, Saturday, September 26 and Sunday, September 27, 2026, at the plaza west of the main hall of Senso-ji. This is the first time the event is being held at Senso-ji.

Marking 15 years since the Great East Japan Earthquake, the event introduces the recovering Hamadori region through panels and videos, with a total of 16 booths under three themes: "Eat," "Buy," and "Experience."

**Eat**

- Assorted grilled seafood (Agura-ya)
- Deep-fried mehikari (Joban-ya)
- Hama no Karaage fried chicken and Kawamata Shamo chicken menchi-katsu (Tamageta-ya)
- Namie yakisoba (Men no Asahiya)
- Fukushima beef skewers and more (Torejion Fukushima Store)

An eating area will also be available at the venue.

**Buy**

Craft sake (haccoba), craft beer (Hop Japan), "Iwaki Kotobuki" from Suzuki Shuzoten, Obori Soma ware with a history of about 300 years, and more will be on sale. A limited-quantity sale of Fukushima-grown "pears" will also be held.

**Experience**

- Obori Soma ware painting experience (fee required): make an original chopstick rest
- Soma Nomaoi VR video experience (free)
- Introduction to the Fukushima Hamadori Cycle Route

An opening ceremony is scheduled for 10:30 on the first day, Saturday, September 26.

**Event Details**

- Dates and times: Saturday, September 26 and Sunday, September 27, 2026, 10:00–17:00
- Venue: Plaza west of the Senso-ji main hall (2-3-1 Asakusa, Taito-ku, Tokyo)
- Admission: Free (some experience programs require a fee)
- Organizer: Fukushima Soso Reconstruction Promotion Organization (public interest incorporated association)
- Held rain or shine (may be canceled or modified in case of severe weather)

Products will end once sold out, so if there is something you want, we recommend arriving early.

210.title: Autumn Equinox Special Paper-Cut Goshuin
210.summary: Asakusa Shrine will distribute a special paper-cut goshuin (shrine stamp) commemorating the Autumn Equinox Day from September 23 to 25.
210.body:
Asakusa Shrine is distributing a special paper-cut goshuin to commemorate the Autumn Equinox (Shubun) on September 23.

The distribution period is scheduled from Wednesday, September 23 (public holiday) to Friday, September 25. Please note that quantities are limited, and distribution will end as soon as they run out.

Reception hours are 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. on public holidays and 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on weekdays. The offering (hatsuho-ryo) is 1,000 yen.

The goshuin is given by attaching it to your goshuincho (stamp book), so **you must bring your goshuincho**. The paper alone is not provided.

Also, distribution is limited to one per person, and please be aware in advance that the design may change.

Visitors who want a limited-edition goshuin to mark the Autumn Equinox are advised to visit early.

211.title: Talk Show & Signed Book Handout Event Commemorating the Release of "Hata Michiko, Being a Wonderful Auntie"
211.summary: A talk show and signed book handout event commemorating the release of actress Michiko Hata's latest essay collection will be held at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
211.body:
To commemorate the release of actress Michiko Hata's latest essay collection, "Hata Michiko, Being a Wonderful Auntie" (Hata Michiko, Suteki na Obasan Yattemasu), on October 2, 2026, a release commemoration talk show and signed book handout event will be held at Asakusa Kokono Theater.

The venue is Asakusa Kokono Theater on the 2nd floor of Asakusa Kokono Club, 2-16-2 Asakusa, Taito-ku, Tokyo. The event takes place for one day only on October 12, 2026 (Monday, national holiday), in two sessions: Session 1 (doors open 11:00, starts 11:30) and Session 2 (doors open 13:30, starts 14:00).

The program consists of a talk show (approximately 20 minutes) followed by a signed book handout. The ticket price is 6,000 yen (tax included), which includes the cost of a book signed by Michiko Hata herself.

Tickets are available through "TicketDive." Coinciding with the release of the essay collection, this is a rare opportunity to hear directly from the author herself, and an event not to be missed by fans.

212.title: Discover Fukushima Hamadori 2026
212.summary: An event introducing the delicious food, traditional culture, and natural beauty of Fukushima's "Hamadori" region will be held on the grounds of Senso-ji Temple.
212.body:
The event "Discover Fukushima Hamadori 2026," which showcases the appeal of the Hamadori region of Fukushima Prefecture, will be held on the grounds of Senso-ji Temple.

Hamadori is an area stretching along the Pacific coast of Fukushima Prefecture, with a wide range of attractions including rich food culture, traditional performing arts, and majestic nature. At this event, a variety of **delicious food**, **traditional culture**, and **local nature** unique to the region will be introduced and presented.

The event takes place on Saturday, September 26 and Sunday, September 27, from 10:00 to 17:00, and is designed so that tourists visiting Senso-ji can easily drop by.

It is a valuable opportunity to experience Fukushima's local culture along with your Asakusa sightseeing. Details can also be found on the official event website.

213.title: October Shakoya: "The World of Medicinal Cuisine – Beauty-Boosting Sweet Soups"
213.summary: Asakusa Shrine will hold its October Shakoya session, a program for learning about traditional Japanese culture, with a lecture on the theme of medicinal cuisine (yakuzen).
213.body:
With the aim of passing on traditional Japanese culture, Asakusa Shrine regularly opens its shrine office to hold a learning program called "Shakoya." It offers a valuable opportunity for people of all ages, from children to adults, to learn about Shinto, shrines, and festivals, as well as ancient traditional culture, customs, performing arts, and crafts.

It is held on the 1st of every month (except January and July). On weekdays it starts at 6:00 p.m., and on weekends and public holidays it starts at 4:00 p.m. Participation is free, but participants cannot attend barefoot, so please wear socks or stockings. Advance reservations are required via the reservation form, by phone, or in person at the shrine office.

The October 2026 Shakoya, titled "The World of Medicinal Cuisine – Beauty-Boosting Sweet Soups," will focus on learning about yakuzen. Yakuzen is a dietary approach that combines ingredients according to an individual's physical condition and the season, aiming to prevent illness and maintain health. It has been planned as an opportunity to reflect on your own body as the weather grows colder.

215.title: Taiwanese Castella Specialty Shop "Tai Le Dan Gao" to Open Pop-Up Store at Asakusa EkiMise
215.summary: Taiwanese castella specialty shop "Tai Le Dan Gao (台楽蛋糕)" will open a limited-time pop-up store at Asakusa EkiMise from September 23 to 29, 2026.
215.body:
Taiwanese castella specialty shop "Tai Le Dan Gao (台楽蛋糕)," operated by BOC Japan LLC, which runs franchises of Taiwanese food shops, will open a limited-time pop-up store at the event space in front of the automatic doors on the 1st floor of "Asakusa EkiMise" from Wednesday, September 23 to Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

The brand opened its Tokyu Plaza Ginza store in March 2021, and became so popular that a long line stretched all the way to Ginza Station from the first day. Specialty staff who trained in Taiwan come to Japan to faithfully recreate the authentic method, while using high-quality Japanese ingredients.

Taiwanese castella, known as "xian kao dan gao" (freshly baked cake), is a homestyle sweet that has long been loved in Taiwan. Its appeal lies in its fluffy texture, baked on the spot, and its gentle sweetness. The products of "Tai Le Dan Gao" are slowly baked using fresh egg yolks, milk, carefully selected flour and meringue, and are known for their signature "fuwaa-shuwaa" (soft and melt-in-your-mouth) texture.

**Product Lineup**

- Premium Plain Castella
- Half & Half Set (Plain × Chocolate / Earl Grey / Browned Butter Vanilla Sugar)
- Premium Quarter Series (Plain / Cheese / Chocolate / Uji Matcha)
- Taiwanese Castella Pudding (Plain / Uji Matcha / Chocolate / Earl Grey)

Business hours are 9:45–20:10 (following the building's operating hours), open every day during the event period. However, the shop may close temporarily due to natural disasters, maintenance, or other reasons. If you visit Asakusa EkiMise, this will be a rare chance to enjoy an authentic taste that is sure to draw a long line.

216.title: Three Meeting Rooms "TIME SHARING Tawaramachi USUI ANNEX" Open Near Tawaramachi and Kuramae
216.summary: Adbar Co., Ltd. opened three rental meeting rooms and rental spaces accommodating up to 40 people in Kotobuki, Taito-ku, Tokyo, on September 18.
216.body:
Adbar Co., Ltd. opened three venues on the 5th, 6th, and 7th floors of "TIME SHARING Tawaramachi USUI ANNEX" in Kotobuki, Taito-ku, Tokyo, on September 18, 2026.

**Each of the three floors suits a different purpose**

- 5th floor (44.09 ㎡): Seats up to 33 people in classroom style. Equipped with tables for three, casters chairs, a 55-inch large monitor, and more
- 7th floor (35.12 ㎡): Seats up to 25 people in classroom style. Also has a permanently installed large monitor and whiteboard

All three venues are open from 8:00 to 23:00, with a minimum usage time of 2 hours. Wi-Fi is free, and wired connections are also supported.

Food and alcohol at the level of a business networking event may be brought in (a bring-in fee applies for anything other than soft drinks), but catering is not supported.

Rates are 2,530 yen per hour for the 5th floor, 1,100 yen per hour for the 6th floor, and 1,870 yen per hour for the 7th floor (all tax included). The spaces can be used from one hour, which makes them convenient. They are expected to be used for a wide range of purposes, including meetings, training, seminars, and workshops.

217.title: Kiruhatotte vol.7 "Soro Soro Dance." (Time to Dance, Soon.)
217.summary: A new production by the theater company Kirihatotte. A stage work depicting the life story of a protagonist graduating from idol life in a collage-like style will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Theater.
217.body:
"Soro Soro Dance.", the latest production by the theater company "Kirihatotte" (playwright and director Mao Yamamoto and actor Nao Yoshizawa), will be performed at Asakusa Kokono Theater from Thursday, November 19 to Sunday, November 22, 2026.

The story begins on the day "Atataka Haruhi" graduates from being an idol, as she starts to talk about her life in the middle of the Budokan. Using the emotional speech that is a staple of graduation concerts as a motif, the piece is structured as a life story that cuts out and collages every possibility of "Atataka Haruhi."

The cast includes Kana Izawa, Chiho Nakajima, Mikio Okuyama, Rin Kawai, Nao Yoshizawa (Kirihatotte), and Xu Yonghang (Zaji Zoo), among others. The staff includes talented members such as Kotaro Ono (dramaturg), Haruka Takasaki (stage manager), and Aoi Ito (set designer).

Kirihatotte is known for its catchphrase "Cutting and pasting a collage of 'certainly' that might exist," and for a style that connects the feelings of people living today to familiar motifs and strange settings. The company has won many awards, including the Sato Sakichi Award 2022 for Outstanding Direction, and the Sato Sakichi Award 2025 for Outstanding Script and Outstanding Lead Actor. In 2026, "Galapagos" became a runner-up Grand Prix candidate at the "CoRich Performing Arts Festival! 2026 Spring."

There are 6 performances in total: November 19 at 19:15; November 20 at 14:00 and 19:15; November 21 at 14:00 and 19:15; and November 22 at 12:30 and 17:00. Doors open 30 minutes before the start of each performance. Children under school age are not admitted.

Tickets are 3,800 yen for general admission, 3,500 yen for U-30, and 3,000 yen for U-22 (all seats unreserved). They are available through Corich and Lawson Ticket.

Enka singer Toshimi Tagawa held her 35th anniversary debut concert on September 29, 2026, at **Asakusa Public Hall** in Taito-ku.

Since making her debut on April 1, 1992, with "Onna... Hitori Tabi," she has produced many hit songs, including appearing four times on NHK's Kohaku Uta Gassen. Her commemorative song "Inochi Kagerou," released on April 22 this year, has become a long-running hit, ranking No. 1 on the "Monthly USEN HIT Enka/Kayokyoku Ranking."

- Approximately 1,000 fans attended
- In the first half, she performed "Aishuu Minato," "Hanakangetsu," and "Shakunage no Hana," as well as cover songs such as "Kita no Yado kara" and "Ai Sansan"
- In the second half, she performed "Kamen Rider Ondo," released in June, backed by six student dancers
- She sang her new song "Inochi Kagerou," and for the encore, passionately performed her debut song "Onna... Hitori Tabi"

Congratulatory messages arrived from author Hiroyuki Itsuki and from IKKO, who supervised her hairstyling, and Tagawa was deeply moved.

Tagawa said, "I am grateful for every encounter, and I want to keep growing always." An Osaka performance is also scheduled for October 24 at Sankei Hall Breeze in Osaka.

258.body:
## Overview

A lecture commemorating the 10th anniversary of the World Heritage inscription of "The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, an Outstanding Contribution to the Modern Movement" will be held at the Taito City Lifelong Learning Center. It is an event unique to Taito City, whose National Museum of Western Art is one of the component sites.

- **Date & Time**: Sunday, November 29, 2026, 3:00 PM–5:00 PM (doors open at 2:30 PM)
- **Venue**: Millennium Hall, 2F, Taito City Lifelong Learning Center (3-25-16 Nishi-Asakusa, Taito-ku, Tokyo)

- **Admission**: Free

## Speakers

- Hiroshi Matsukuma (Professor, Kanagawa University)
- Rei Kikukawa (Actor)
- Kyo Fukuda (Chief Researcher and Head of the World Heritage Office, National Museum of Western Art)
- Kazuhiko Nishi (Senior Specialist for Cultural Properties, International Cooperation for Cultural Heritage Office, Agency for Cultural Affairs)

## How to Apply

You can apply online (electronic application) or by return postcard (reply-paid postcard). On the postcard, clearly write "World Heritage 10th Anniversary Lecture Participation Request" and include your name, address, and contact information. If you work or study in Taito City, please also include the name of your workplace (school). One postcard is valid for one person. Send it to: World Heritage Section, Urban Exchange Division, Taito City Office, 4-5-6 Higashi-Ueno, Taito-ku, Tokyo 110-8615.

The application deadline is Friday, November 6, 2026 (must arrive by this date). If applications exceed capacity, a lottery will be held, with priority given to those who live, work, or study in Taito City. Results will be notified by email or by the reply postcard. For inquiries, contact the World Heritage Section (03-5246-1193).

259.title: Sale of the Reiwa 9 (2027) Taito City Tourism Calendar "Edo Four Seasons Calendar Painted by Hokusai, Kuniyoshi and Eisen"
259.summary: Taito City will sell the Reiwa 9 (2027) Taito City Tourism Calendar, featuring Edo-period famous places and events painted by Hokusai, Kuniyoshi and Eisen, from November 1 at 1,000 yen (tax included) per copy.
259.body:
Taito City will sell the Reiwa 9 (2027) Taito City Tourism Calendar, "Edo Four Seasons Calendar Painted by Hokusai, Kuniyoshi and Eisen." The calendar mainly collects works by three ukiyo-e artists active in the late Edo period, Katsushika Hokusai, Utagawa Kuniyoshi and Keisai Eisen, depicting famous places and events in Taito City.

## Highlights

- Hokusai's "Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji," famous in Japan and around the world
- Kuniyoshi's rare uchiwa-e (fan print) "Gogyo no Uchi: Asagao no Dosho"
- Eisen's "Eight Views of Edo," which depicts the scenes of the time in fine detail

With works that showcase the distinct styles of the three artists, this calendar lets you feel Edo culture up close. The size is B3 (510 × 350 mm).

## Sales Information

- **Price**: 1,000 yen per copy (tax included)
- **Sales period (planned)**: From Sunday, November 1 to Sunday, January 31, Reiwa 9 (2027). At the Taito City Office, sales start on Monday, November 2. Sales may end early depending on stock.
- **Where to buy**: Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center, "SHOP Taito" on the 1st floor of Taito City Office, Tourist Information Desk Asakusa, Asakura Museum of Sculpture, Ichiyo Memorial Hall, Shitamachi Museum, Calligraphy Museum (Shodo Hakubutsukan), Former Tokyo Music School Sogakudo Concert Hall, Tokyo Tourist Information Center (Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building), Japan Map Center, and others. You can also buy it through the Japan Map Center's online shop.

## Purchase by Mail

Send a purchase application form, payment (by cash registered mail) and postage (in stamps) to the Calendar Desk, Tourism Division, Taito City Office. Postage is 660 yen worth of stamps for 1 copy and 920 yen worth for 2 copies. Please check the city's official page for details.

261.body:
Nagahama City, Shiga Prefecture, a partner city of Taito City, will hold "Kannon Culture Alive in Kohoku and Nagahama: 1st Panel Exhibition" at the Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center, introducing the Kannon culture handed down in the city.

Asakusa is known for the Kannon faith of Senso-ji, so this exhibition offers a chance to feel a connection with the Kannon culture of Nagahama City. It is a free exhibition you can easily drop in on while sightseeing in Asakusa.

Organized by the Historical Townscape Office, Culture and Tourism Division, Nagahama City, Shiga Prefecture (TEL: 0749-65-6510). For inquiries to the Taito City office, contact the Urban Exchange Division (TEL: 03-5246-1016).

262.title: Asakusa Shrine Recruiting Full-Time Shinto Priests
262.summary: Asakusa Shrine is recruiting a few full-time Shinto priests (shusshi). Those who aspire to become priests in the future may also join as trainees.
262.body:
Asakusa Shrine is looking for people to serve as full-time Shinto priests (shusshi).

## Job Description
Duties include conducting ceremonies before the deity, cleaning the shrine buildings and grounds, and helping prepare and run festivals such as the Sanja Festival. You will also take part in passing on traditional culture, educational activities for young people, and local social welfare activities. It is also a valuable opportunity to acquire the knowledge, education, and etiquette of a Shinto priest. Those who aspire to become priests in the future may first join as trainees.

## Requirements
- Position: Shusshi (service period of 1–2 years)
- Number of positions: A few
- Conditions: Men and women aged 20 or older (high school graduate or above), Shinto priest qualification (Chokkai or higher), standard driver's license
- Required documents: Resume, personal statement, copy of rank certificate
- Selection: Document screening, followed by an interview and written exam

## Work and Benefits

270.title: Hotel Asakusa View Annex Rokku Selected for the Second Year in a Row as a "Selected Hotel" in the MICHELIN Guide Hotel Selection 2026
